aids.nom: Colombia Mayor — Subsidio económico al adulto mayor
aids.description_en: Non-contributory monthly cash transfer for adults aged 60+ (men) or 55+ (women) living in extreme poverty with no pension. Amount: COP 80,000–90,000/month paid bimonthly (COP 160,000–180,000 every two months). Administered by the DPS (Departamento para la Prosperidad Social). Application through Colombia Mayor offices or Corresponsales Bancarios. Source: dps.gov.co.
aids.organisme: DPS — Departamento para la Prosperidad Social

aids.description_en: Contributory old-age pension under the public RPM scheme (Colpensiones) or private RAIS scheme (AFP). Minimum pension: 1 SMMLV = COP 1,300,000/month in 2025. Requires 1,150 weeks of contributions (RPM) and age 62 (men) / 57 (women). Administered by Colpensiones for RPM or private AFP for RAIS. Source: colpensiones.gov.co.

Non-contributory cash transfer of COP 160,000/month for households in extreme poverty not covered by other social programs (Familias en Acción, Jóvenes en Acción, Colombia Mayor). Administered by DPS. Beneficiaries identified via SISBEN IV. Source: dps.gov.co.
aids.organisme: DPS — Departamento para la Prosperidad Social

aids.description_en: Conditional cash transfer (CCT) program: COP 160,000–200,000 bimonthly per child for nutrition and education conditionalities. Targets households in poverty and extreme poverty with children aged 0–18 enrolled in school. Administered by DPS. Conditionalities: school attendance and health checkups. Source: dps.gov.co.
aids.organisme: DPS — Departamento para la Prosperidad Social

aids.description_en: Cash transfer of COP 400,000 bimonthly (COP 200,000/month effective) for young people aged 16–24 from vulnerable households enrolled in higher education (SENA technical or university). Conditionality: academic performance. Administered by DPS. Source: dps.gov.co.
aids.organisme: DPS — Departamento para la Prosperidad Social

aids.description_en: Unemployment protection mechanism for formal workers who lose their job. Workers with less than 1 year of severance (cesantías) fund accrue a monthly subsidy of approximately COP 650,000 for up to 6 months. Access via severance fund (Fondo de Cesantías). Requires having contributed to a formal pension fund. Source: mintrabajo.gov.co.
aids.organisme: Ministerio del Trabajo / Fondos de Cesantías

aids.description_en: Flagship social protection program replacing Ingreso Solidario and partially replacing other transfers. COP 500,000 bimonthly (COP 250,000/month effective) for households in poverty and extreme poverty identified via SISBEN IV. Includes conditionalities on health and education. Administered by DPS. Source: dps.gov.co.
aids.organisme: DPS — Departamento para la Prosperidad Social

aids.description_en: Child welfare programs by ICBF (Instituto Colombiano de Bienestar Familiar): childcare, nutrition, and early childhood development for children under 5 in vulnerable families. Not a direct cash transfer but provides subsidized childcare and meals. Access through local ICBF offices. Source: icbf.gov.co.
aids.organisme: ICBF — Instituto Colombiano de Bienestar Familiar

aids.description_en: Subsidized healthcare coverage for people identified as poor/vulnerable by SISBEN IV. Provides free access to the POS (Plan Obligatorio de Salud) including primary care, hospitalization, medications, and maternity. Enrollment through local EPS-S (Entidades Promotoras de Salud Subsidiadas). Source: minsalud.gov.co.

aids.nom: Mi Casa Ya — Subsidio Familiar de Vivienda
aids.description_en: One-time housing subsidy up to 50 SMMLV (COP 65,000,000 in 2025) for purchase of first home (VIS housing up to 135 SMMLV). Income-tested: monthly income ≤ 2 SMMLV (COP 2,600,000). Administered by Ministerio de Vivienda / Fonvivienda. Source: minvivienda.gov.co.
